item.title: Pizza van parked in residential road, cooking and selling food, 11th September
item.description:
This large van is constantly parked in this position, taking up 2 residential parking spaces in Morgan Road. Given the van’s signage it belongs to the Sapore Vero restaurant at 51 College Road. It is being used to cook and serve food to the public - see the blackboard signage outside the restaurant advertising the Pizza Van. Does it have/require a licence to be doing this? Another large van belonging to the same company is also constantly parked in Morgan Road taking up the already pressured residential parking situation in the road. Parking is difficult enough as it is in the road without a company using residential parking spaces to store their vehicles.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Morgan Road, Plaistow, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
